horizon.pages.music.empty: Awekho amathrekhi omculo: imisindo yegeyimu ayilayishiwe.
horizon.pages.music.tooltip: Amathrekhi akhelwe ngaphakathi, ngokwesimo: dlala eyodwa manje, noma vala noma yimaphi ukuze igeyimu iyeke ukuyikhetha.
horizon.pages.settings.tooltip: Izilungiselelo zika-Horizon: ihluzo, izilawuli, okungeziwe nama-mod.
horizon.pages.graphics.tooltip: Imidwebo, kalula: isilungiselelo ngasinye sisho ukuthi kubizani.
horizon.pages.graphics_advanced.tooltip: Zonke izilungiselelo zehluzo, Horizon zifakiwe, nokuthi ngayinye ibiza malini.
horizon.pages.controller.tooltip: Izilawuli: izinkinobho zazo, izinti, ukudlidliza nokuzulazula kwemenyu.
horizon.pages.extras.tooltip: Izengezo ozikhethela, zonke zivaliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo: umdlalo uhlala u-vanilla uze uvule eyodwa.
horizon.pages.agent.tooltip: Vumela umenzeli wakho we-AI ukuthi adlale: amaklayenti e-horizon-ctl kanye ne-MCP kule khompyutha.
horizon.pages.split_profiles.tooltip: Ubani odlalayo: iphrofayela egcinwe kule folda yegeyimu.
horizon.pages.split_setup.tooltip: Amawindi namamonitha, nokuthi ubani odlala kuphi.
horizon.pages.shader_packs.tooltip: Amaphakethe e-Shader asuka kufolda yama-shaderpacks: Horizon's siqu kanye nalawo aku-shader/ format. Omunye ugijima ngesikhathi.
horizon.pages.mods.tooltip: Amamodi enzelwe okuthi Horizon, asuka kufolda yamamodyu e-horizon. Ngayinye igijima ku-sandbox futhi ihlale icishiwe uze uyivule.
horizon.mods.empty: Awekho ama-mods: faka amafayela e-.hmod kufolda yama-mods omkhathizwe
horizon.shader_packs.empty: Awekho amaphakethe e-shader: wabeke kufolda ye-shaderpacks
Your display or system doesn't offer HDR: Isibonisi sakho noma isistimu ayinikezi okukhiphayo kwe-HDR.
Your GPU or graphics API doesn't support: I-GPU yakho noma i-API yezithombe ayikusekeli.
Full-detail terrain range. LOD Distance: Ibanga lendawo enemininingwane egcwele. Ibanga le-LOD linganweba imihlaba yendawo kude.
Indawo eqhelile ekude emhlabeni wasendaweni. Ama-GPU ahlanganisiwe ame kuma-chunks ayi-128.
Reduced draws far terrain coarser: faste: Okuncishisiwe kudonsa indawo ebanzi kakhulu: ngokushesha kule GPU ehlanganisiwe.
Reduced draws far terrain coarser, for G: Ukuncishiswa kudonsa indawo ebanzi kakhulu, kuma-GPU kuyehla.
Field of view. Wider shows more terrain: Inkambu yokubuka. Ububanzi bubonisa indawo eningi ngesikhathi esisodwa.
Caps frames per second; a cap saves powe: Ozimele bezinhlamvu ngomzuzwana; ikepisi yonga amandla nokushisa.
Waits for the display's refresh: no tear: Ilindele ukuvuselelwa kwesibonisi: akukho ukudabuka, ukubambezeleka okuncane.
Sets the options below together. Changin: Isetha izinketho ezingezansi ndawonye. Ukushintsha eyodwa kwenza kube Custom.
Lava, fire and sunlight shine brighter t: Udaka, umlilo nokukhanya kwelanga kukhanya ngaphezu kokumhlophe. Idinga isibonisi se-HDR.
Your display's darkest black. 0 for OLED: Isibonisi sakho simnyama kakhulu. 0 ye-OLED; Ama-LCD akhanya kancane.
How bright highlights get. Auto: the pea: Yeka ukuthi amaphuzu avelele akhanya kanjani. Okuzenzakalelayo: inani eliphakeme elibika isistimu yakho.
How bright white paper and menus look. A: Yeka ukuthi kubukeka kanjani iphepha elimhlophe namamenyu. Okuzenzakalelayo: ideskithophu yakho imhlophe.
How bright the HUD and menus are, agains: Yeka ukuthi i-HUD namamenyu akhanya kangakanani, ngokumelene nephepha elimhlophe.
How far mobs, crops and machines keep wo: Ukude kangakanani izixuku, izitshalo nemishini iqhubeka nokusebenza. Isikhathi se-CPU.
How far away mobs and items are drawn, a: Ukude kangakanani izixuku nezinto ezidonswayo, njengesabelo sokujwayelekile.
Skips terrain hidden behind closed secti: Yeqa indawo efihlwe ngemuva kwezingxenye ezivaliwe. Ukuvala kubiza kakhulu.
Ukuhlolwa kwe-CPU occlusion kusebenzisa lolu hlaka.
Meshed sections uploaded per frame. Lowe: Izigaba ezinemeshi ezilayishwa ngozimele ngamunye. Okuphansi kuyashelela ngenkathi ilayisha.
Soft shadows in corners. Costs chunk bui: Izithunzi ezithambile emakhoneni. Izindleko zesikhathi sokwakha ingxenye kuphela.
Smaller copies of block textures for dis: Amakhophi amancane okwakheka kwebhulokhi yendawo ekude: okucwebezelayo okuncane.
Blends grass and water colours across bi: Ihlanganisa imibala yotshani namanzi kuwo wonke ama-biomes lapho wakha izingcezu.
Cloud layer: off, flat (fast) or 3D (fan: Isendlalelo samafu: sivaliwe, siphansi (ngokushesha) noma i-3D (enhle).
Distance fog. Off shows the edge of the: Inkungu yebanga. Okuvaliwe kubonisa unqenqema lomhlaba olayishiwe.
Ukude kangakanani imvula neqhwa eduze kwakho.
Leaves with see-through gaps. Off draws: Amaqabunga anezikhala zokubona. Off iwadonsa aqine.
Sorts water and glass more exactly behin: Uhlunga amanzi nengilazi ngokuthe ngqo ngemva kokunye.
Which chunk rebuilds wait for the frame:: Iyiphi ingxenye eyakha kabusha ilinda uhlaka: akukho, eduze noma eyakho.
Animates water, lava, fire and other mov: Iphilisa amanzi, i-lava, umlilo nokunye ukwakheka okunyakazayo.
World pixels per screen pixel. Below 100: Amaphikseli omhlaba ngephikseli ngayinye yesikrini. Ngaphansi kuka-100% kuyashesha ku-GPU.
Smooths jagged edges. FXAA: softer. TAA:: Bushelelezi emaphethelweni amagebhugebhu. I-FXAA: ithambile. I-TAA: Okushelelayo, izinto ezihambayo zingase zilandele.
Renders the world smaller and rebuilds i: Yenza umhlaba ube mncane futhi uwakhe kabusha nge-TAA. Ngokushesha, kuthambile.
HDR output on an HDR display: lava, fire: Okukhiphayo kwe-HDR kusibonisi se-HDR: udaka, umlilo nokukhanya kwelanga kukhanya kakhudlwana.
How frames reach the screen while VSync: Indlela ozimele abafika ngayo esikrinini ngenkathi i-VSync icishiwe.
Efficient sleeps until the next frame; P: Ukulala kahle kuze kube uhlaka olulandelayo; Ama-spins aqondile, njenge-vanilla.
Lowers the frame rate when minimised, or: Yehlisa izinga lozimele uma lincishisiwe, noma lingenzi lutho futhi.
60 FPS cap (30 in menus or unfocused), h: 60 FPS cap (30 kumamenyu noma unfocused), ingxenye yezisebenzi: amandla amancane.
Threads that generate, light and mesh ch: Imicu ekhiqiza, izingcezu ezilula nezinemeshi. Isiqalo esilandelayo.
Vulkan, then DirectX 12 (Windows) or Ope: Vulkan, bese DirectX 12 (Windows) noma OpenGL (Linux) lapho ihluleka khona. Isiqalo esilandelayo.
Water and glass in one buffer: fewer dra: Amanzi nengilazi kubhafa eyodwa: izingcingo ezidonsayo ezimbalwa, i-VRAM eyengeziwe. Isiqalo esilandelayo.
Mesh data sent to the GPU per frame. Low: Idatha ye-Mesh ithunyelwe ku-GPU ngozimele ngamunye. Okuphansi kuyashelela ngenkathi ilayisha.
Frame rate and frame times over the game: Izinga lozimele nezikhathi zozimele phezu kwegeyimu, ngegrafu.
horizon.multiplayer.not_signed_in: Le seva ikumodi ye-inthanethi. Ngena ngemvume nge-akhawunti yakho Microsoft kusiqalisi Horizon ukuze usijoyine.
Ubona kude kangakanani, iwindi kanye ne-HUD.
The sky and weather, lighting, textures: Isibhakabhaka nesimo sezulu, ukukhanya, indlela yokwenza kanye nesithombe.
Ukulayishwa kwe-Chunk, ukukhipha kanye nokusetshenziswa kwamandla.
How frames reach the screen, and the per: Indlela ozimele abafika ngayo esikrinini, kanye nembondela yokusebenza.
horizon.extras.fullbright.tooltip: Bonisa amabhlogo namabhizinisi ekukhanyeni okuphelele, ngisho nasezindaweni ezimnyama.
horizon.extras.dynamic_lights.tooltip: Amathoshi neminye imithombo yokukhanya ebanjiwe, ewisayo noma evuthayo ikhanyisa amabhulokhi azungezile.
horizon.extras.own_name_tag.tooltip: Ibonisa igama lakho ngaphezu kwekhanda lakho kumuntu wesithathu, njengoba abanye abadlali beyibona. Kufihliwe uma iseva ifihla amagama eqembu lakho noma awubonakali.
horizon.extras.hide_block_particles.tool: Ifihla izinhlayiya zemfucumfucu eziqhuma kubhlokhi ephukile bese zidilika kulena omayini. Ezinye izinhlayiya zihlala.
horizon.extras.auto_reconnect.tooltip: Ujoyina kabusha iseva ngemva kokuxhumeka okulahlekile noma ukuqalisa kabusha, hhayi ngemva kokukhahlelwa noma ukuvinjelwa.
horizon.extras.ui_sound_reserve.tooltip: Imisindo emhlabeni ishiya iziteshi zomsindo ezingu-16 kwangu-247 zikhululekile, ngakho isikhukhula sazo (ukuqhuma okukhulu) asikwazi ukuthulisa ukuchofoza kwemenyu.
horizon.extras.music_page.tooltip: Umculo & Imisindo ithola Umculo... ikhasi: dlala noma iyiphi ingoma eyakhelwe ngaphakathi manje, noma vala eyodwa ukuze igeyimu iyeke ukuyikhetha. Akukho okushintshayo uze uvale ithrekhi.
horizon.extras.mouse_tweaks.tooltip: Hudula kwesokudla indawo eyodwa ngesikhala ngasinye, ukuhudula kwesokunxele kuqoqa into ebanjiwe, u-Shift + kwesokunxele-hudula unyaka wonke.
horizon.extras.mouse_tweaks_wheel.toolti: Phansi ithumela into eyodwa ye-slot kolunye uhlangothi, phezulu ibuyisela eyodwa.
horizon.extras.sort.tooltip: Ihlunga i-inventory, isifuba, imiphongolo, isifuba se-ender namabhokisi e-shulker ngokulandelana kwethebhu yokudala, ukuhlanganisa izitaki.
horizon.extras.sort_key.tooltip: Uhlunga ingxenye ngaphansi kwekhesa. Chofoza, bese ucindezela inkinobho; I-Escape iyayikhulula.
horizon.extras.no_ai.tooltip: Ifihla futhi ivale zonke izici ze-AI: isilawuli somenzeli, i-horizon-ctl namaseva e-MCP. Iswishi yesiqalisi nayo.
horizon.extras.agent_control.tooltip: Umenzeli wakho we-AI angadlala le geyimu ngokusebenzisa i-horizon-ctl noma iklayenti le-MCP, kule khompyutha kuphela.
horizon.extras.discord_presence.tooltip: Ibonisa Okudlalayo Horizon kuphrofayela yakho Discord ngenkathi Discord igijima: amamenyu, umdlali oyedwa noma abadlali abaningi, ubukhulu kanye nesikhathi esidlalwayo. Ungalokothi igama lomhlaba noma ikheli leseva.
Sets the three below full screen, one te: Isetha okuthathu ngezansi kwesikrini esigcwele, isithombe esisodwa sokuhlola ngesikhathi.
A key that opens this screen from the ga: Ukhiye ovula lesi sikrini kugeyimu. Ayiboshiwe ekuqaleni.
Your display didn't say how bright it ge: Isibonisi sakho asishongo ukuthi kukhanya kangakanani: linganisa ukuze usimise.
Already set up for your display. Only ca: Usuvele usethelwe isibonisi sakho. Linganisa kuphela uma i-HDR ibonakala ingalungile.
Puts Peak Brightness and Paper White bac: Ibuyisela Ukukhanya Okuphakeme Nokumhlophe Kwephepha emuva ekusetheni isibonisi sakho.
Set up for your display. Leave on Auto u: Setha isibonisi sakho. Hamba ku-Auto ngaphandle uma kubukeka kungalungile.
Lower it until the logo just disappears: Yehlise kuze kube yilapho uphawu luvele lunyamalale lube mnyama.
Raise it until the logo just disappears: Yiphakamise kuze kube yilapho ilogo ivele inyamalale esikweleni esikhanyayo.
Make the card a white that's comfortable: Yenza ikhadi libe mhlophe okunethezekayo ukulibuka isikhathi eside, ekukhanyeni odlala kukho.
horizon.friends.title: Dlala nabangani
horizon.friends.hint: Abangane banamathisele ikhodi ngemva kwenkinobho yesikrini esithi Abangane, ku-Direct Connection, noma ekhasini elithi Dlala lesiqalisi.
horizon.friends.share_intro: Yabelana ngalo mhlaba ngemuva kwekhodi yesimemo: ivula i-LAN, futhi abangani abaku-inthanethi bajoyine nekhodi. Ayikho iseva yethu ehilelekile.
horizon.friends.short_code_changed: Othile uhlale ezama ikhodi emfushane engalungile, ngakho yashintsha.
horizon.friends.code_ready: Ikhodi yakho yesimemo isilungile: Imenyu yegeyimu, Dlala nabangani. Ikopishe bese uyithumela kubangani bakho.
horizon.extras.chat_animation.tooltip: Ulayini omusha wengxoxo ungena usuka kwesokunxele ngenkathi ufiphala, esikhundleni sokuthi ubonakale uphelele.
horizon.extras.wheel_cycles_settings.too: Isondo lokuskrola phezu kwenkinobho kuzilungiselelo lishintsha inani lalo, njengaku-vanilla. Icishiwe, isondo liskrola uhlu kuphela.
horizon.extras.pack_browser.tooltip: Khetha Amaphekhi Ensiza ithola inkinobho ethi Engeza esesha okuthi Modrinth bese ifaka iphekhi kufolda yamaphekhi akho. Valiwe, igeyimu ayilokothi ixhumane Modrinth.
horizon.extras.splitscreen.tooltip: Emhlabeni, esinye isilawuli singajoyina njengomdlali omusha: cindezela u-A uma sibuza, bese ukhetha iphrofayela nokuthi uzodlala kuphi.
horizon.splitscreen.setup.warning.on_mai: Iwindi %s ligcwalisa ukuqapha kwe-Window 1: abadlali bayo badlala ku-Window 1
horizon.splitscreen.setup.warning.unplug: Iwindi %s Imonitha ayixhunyiwe: abadlali bayo badlala ku-Window 1
horizon.splitscreen.setup.status.enable_: Ivule, bese ucindezela inkinobho kwesinye isilawuli emhlabeni.
horizon.splitscreen.setup.status.join_hi: Cindezela u-A ukuze ujoyine bese ukhetha iphrofayela.
horizon.splitscreen.setup.status.solo_co: Izilawuli eziyedwa kanye nempendulo yesilawuli azishintshile.
horizon.splitscreen.setup.note.select: Chofoza isidlali, noma sihudulele efasiteleni noma kusiqapha.
horizon.splitscreen.setup.note.apply: Faka isicelo sokudlala ngale ndlela, Buyela ukuze uhlehlise.
horizon.splitscreen.setup.switch_disable: Isikrini sokuhlukanisa siyacima uma abanye sebehambile (imenyu yabo yokumisa isikhashana).
horizon.splitscreen.setup.help.layout_au: %s (eceleni lapho iwindi libanzi). Cindezela ukuze ushintshe.
horizon.splitscreen.setup.help.switch: Isikrini esihlukanisiwe sale khompyutha, sivuliwe noma sivaliwe.
horizon.splitscreen.setup.help.identify: Ukubuka komdlali ngamunye kubonisa ukuthi ikuliphi iwindi.
horizon.splitscreen.setup.help.names: Igama lomdlali ngamunye ekhoneni lokubuka kwabo.
horizon.splitscreen.prompt.controller_di: Yixhume kabusha, noma cindezela inkinobho kwenye
horizon.splitscreen.setup.help.give_up_p: Isilawuli sakho siyayeka ukushayela futhi sinikezwa ukujoyina (A).
horizon.splitscreen.setup.note.held_at: %s kuya ku-%s: U-A uyehlisa lapha, u-B uyakubuyisela.
horizon.splitscreen.setup.note.held: %s kuthathwe: kwesokunxele/kwesokudla kukhetha lapho, u-A ewisa, u-B ayibuyisele.
horizon.splitscreen.online_only: Le seva ikumodi ye-inthanethi: amaphrofayela angaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi awakwazi ukuyijoyina, umdlali ngamunye udinga eyakhe Minecraft i-akhawunti.
horizon.splitscreen.own_account: Le seva idinga i-akhawunti Minecraft yomdlali ngamunye
horizon.splitscreen.local_only: Abanye abadlali bangajoyina le seva kuphela nge-akhawunti yabo Minecraft: amaphrofayili angaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi adlala emhlabeni wakho, ku-LAN noma kuseva kunethiwekhi yangakini.
Hides models behind opaque blocks. Async: Ifihla amamodeli ngemuva kwamabhulokhi akhanyayo. I-Async ihlola intambo; umaka wezinhlangano.
Reuses settled boxes; lid movement stays: Isebenzisa kabusha amabhokisi alungisiwe; ukunyakaza kwesivalo kuhlala kugqwayiziwe.
Reuses sign text until text, light, or f: Iphinda isebenzise umbhalo wokusayina kuze kushintshe umbhalo, ukukhanya, noma ifonti.
Reuses still pots; break wobble and sher: Isebenzisa kabusha amabhodwe amile; i-break wobble kanye ne-sherd izinguquko dweba kabusha.
Reuses still bells; ringing stays animat: Isebenzisa kabusha izinsimbi; ukukhala kuhlala kugqwayiziwe.
Reuses closed chests; moving lids stay a: Isebenzisa kabusha isifuba esivaliwe; izivalo ezihambayo zihlala zi-animated.
Reuses poles; flags and pattern layers s: Isebenzisa kabusha izigxobo; amafulegi nezendlalelo zephethini zisabuyekezwa.
Reuses statue geometry until its block s: Isebenzisa kabusha i-geometry yesifanekiso kuze kube yilapho isimo sayo sokuvimba sishintsha.
Wonke amaqabunga abhekene. Amaqabunga ama-vanilla amahle.
Keeps fine plants in high-res packs from: Igcina izitshalo ezinhle emaphaketheni e-high-res ukuthi zingabuni kude.
F2 screenshots at this many times the ga: Izithombe-skrini ze-F2 kulokhu izikhathi eziningi ukulungiswa komdlalo. Okuphakeme kuthatha isikhathi eside.
Shows a made-up frame between each two r: Ibonisa ifreyimu eyenziwe phakathi kwamabili angempela: abushelelezi, aphuze kakhudlwana.
Reuses the pack shadow map when sun, vie: Isebenzisa kabusha imephu yesithunzi yephekhi lapho ilanga, ukubuka nomhlaba kufana. Vala ngokuzenzakalelayo.
On servers, finds their BlueMap web map: Kumaseva, ithola imephu yewebhu ye-BlueMap yendawo ekude. Joyina okulandelayo.
How far around you BlueMap tiles are dow: Ukude kangakanani okukuzungezile amathayili e-BlueMap alandwa. Joyina okulandelayo.
Leaves fully inside a canopy draw solid:: Ishiya ngokugcwele ngaphakathi kwe-canopy idonsa iqinile: izendlalelo ezimbalwa zokubona.
Leaves with one open side draw solid too: Amaqabunga anohlangothi olulodwa oluvulekile adweba aqine futhi: ngokushesha, imiphetho emikhulu.
Drops faces between leaves: faster, but: Iconsa ubuso phakathi kwamaqabunga: ngokushesha, kodwa izikhala zibheke ngaphandle.

horizon.agent.connected.many_ago: Kuxhunyiwe: %s ukuxhumeka kwe-ejenti, umyalo wokugcina %s s edlule
horizon.agent.off: Valiwe: abenzeli abakwazi ukufinyelela le geyimu.
horizon.agent.session_opened: Ivulelwe le seshini uhlelo oluqale igeyimu.
horizon.agent.socket: Isokhethi: %s (kopisha imininingwane ukuze uthole indlela yayo egcwele)
horizon.agent.local_only: Indawo kuphela: abenzeli kule khompyutha, hhayi inethiwekhi.
Hides models behind opaque blocks. Entit: Ifihla amamodeli ngemuva kwamabhulokhi akhanyayo. Amabhizinisi ayabuyekeza. Vala ngamaphekhi angokwezifiso.
horizon.extras.repro_keys.tooltip: I-F3+R iqala noma imise ukuqoshwa kabusha futhi i-F3+E ibhala inqwaba yayo. Vala ngokuzenzakalelayo: amakhophi aqoshiwe emhlabeni jikelele.
horizon.repro.started: Ukuqopha kuqalile; U-F3+R uyayimisa bese ebhala inqwaba.
horizon.extras.cosmetics_mine.tooltip: Kufihliwe: wonke umdlali we-Horizon uyakubona ngaphandle kwezimonyo zakho, ozifakile. Iswishi efanayo njengeWardrobe yesiqalisi.
horizon.extras.cosmetics_others.tooltip: Okugqokwa abanye abadlali Horizon: yonke into, izitayela zabo zamathegi kuphela, noma lutho. Kufihliwe, umdlalo awubuzi ukuthi bagqokani.
horizon.extras.cosmetics_auras.tooltip: I-Auras nemizila egqokwa abanye abadlali. Vala ngokuzenzakalelayo.
